lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Mel's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Overwhelm to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking infinitely.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Overwhelm: Store 20px (+ 25% AP) magic damage on the affected enemy with the first stack, reducedagainst minions. For each stack, store an additional 20px (+ 0.75% AP) magic damage on the target. If the total stored would deal death to the target (including through shields), the next stack will consume them all to deal the damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate - Searing Brilliance: Mel's ability casts each generate 3 stacks of Searing Brilliance for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of Searing Brilliance to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals 5–20|magic damage (+ 1% AP) magic damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: The bolts momentarily grant sight during their travel, while the explosions grant sight over their target area. Both can see through brush and terrain.
